title: New Study: Indian Enterprises Have Funded AI at Scale
description: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], August 5: Two years into what most Indian enterprises describe as a serious commitment to artificial intelligence (AI), boards are still searching for the one metric that matters most: measurable business impact. That is the central finding of the State of AI in Indian Enterprises 2026, a new research report published by ET Edge CIO&Leader. Key findings from the report were unveiled at the 27th CIO&Leader Conference, The Agentic Enterprise, held in Jaipur from July 31 to August 2, 2026.
